title: Headroom: Free Tool to Cut AI Token Usage by 95%
description:
Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and search results before they reach your LLM — saving up to 95% on JSON tokens. Use it as a library, proxy, or MCP server. Install with pip, wrap your agent, and start saving.
